title: Telekinesis
answer: Telekinesis is a innate channel action with control intent. Aspects: FORCE, MIND. Baseline potency 8, range 20.000, duration 80, energy 26, cooldown 200, residue 60, priority 10, and 2 generic presentation beats. Its standard signature uses the force motif, innate_force sound, and colours #B9E7FF / #C27CFF.
